A '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]''' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="FF" /> brought news of the death of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and the acceptance of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]]. Along with the message, she delivered a [[Tobal lens]], which had been a gift from Qui-Gon.
